log_timestamp.description: Whether to prepend log lines with a timestamp.

log_syslog.description: Whether to send logs to syslog in addition to the log file.

logfacility.description: Syslog facility to use when logging to syslog.

enable_ssh.description: Enable simulated SSH service (requires valid SSH host keys).

bind_address.description: IP address to bind all services to (e.g., 127.0.0.1 for localhost only, 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces).

bind_port_http.description: Port to bind the HTTP service to.

bind_port_https.description: Port to bind the HTTPS service to.

bind_port_smtp.description: Port to bind the SMTP service to.

bind_port_dns.description: Port to bind the DNS service to (UDP and TCP).

bind_port_ftp.description: Port to bind the FTP service to.

bind_port_ssh.description: Port to bind the SSH service to.

bind_port_pop3.description: Port to bind the POP3 service to.

bind_port_imap.description: Port to bind the IMAP service to.

bind_port_telnets.description: Port to bind the Telnet service to.

dns_mode.description: Mode for DNS resolution: 'ipv4', 'ipv6', 'ipv4_first', 'ipv6_first', 'none' (disables DNS), or 'wildcard'.

dns_default_ip.description: IP address returned for all DNS queries when dns_mode=none or dns_mode=wildcard.

dns_redirects.description: List of hostnames to override DNS resolution with specific IPs.

ip.description: Target IP address for this hostname.

dns_max_ttl.description: Maximum TTL (in seconds) to use in DNS responses.

http_directory.description: Directory containing HTTP content (web pages, assets).

http_port.description: HTTP service port (overrides bind_port_http for compatibility).

http_default_file.description: Default file served when a directory is requested.

http_error_404.description: File to serve for 404 Not Found responses.

http_mimetypes.description: List of file extensions to MIME type mappings for HTTP responses.

smtp_directory.description: Directory for SMTP spool files and received messages.

smtp_port.description: Port to bind the SMTP service to (overrides bind_port_smtp for compatibility).

smtp_default_file.description: Default filename for received SMTP messages.

smtp_allowed_senders.description: List of allowed sender email addresses (if empty, all senders accepted).

smtp_allowed_recipients.description: List of allowed recipient email addresses (if empty, all recipients accepted).

ssh_port.description: Port to bind the SSH service to (overrides bind_port_ssh for compatibility).

ssh_keys_directory.description: Directory containing SSH host keys (e.g., ssh_host_rsa_key).

ssh_user_directory.description: Directory containing fake SSH user home directories (e.g., /home/user/.ssh/authorized_keys).

ssh_allow_password_auth.description: Allow password authentication for SSH (simulated, no real auth).

ssh_allow_pubkey_auth.description: Allow public key authentication for SSH.

ftp_directory.description: Directory for FTP file content (anonymous and authenticated).

ftp_port.description: Port to bind the FTP service to (overrides bind_port_ftp for compatibility).

ftp_writable.description: Allow writing to FTP server (simulated, no real I/O).

ftp_anonymous.description: Enable anonymous FTP login (user: anonymous, pass: any).

tcp_wrappers.description: TCP Wrappers integration: 'on', 'off', or path to hosts.allow/hosts.deny (e.g., '/etc/hosts.allow').

tcp_timeout.description: TCP connection idle timeout in seconds.

udp_port.description: UDP port to use for DNS (overrides bind_port_dns for compatibility).
